# AIHOT — AI 热点简报 / AI Hot Takes
Real-time aggregator of global AI news from official blogs, English and Chinese media, and community discussions, ordered as a chronological timeline with verifiable sources.

## When to use this site

Use AIHOT when you need a fast, source-linked read on what's happening in AI:

- "What's happening in AI today?" / "今天 AI 圈有什么大事"
- "Recent news about a specific product or company" — e.g. DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google DeepMind, Meta AI
- "Compare coverage across sources for a single event"
- "Quick research brief before writing about an AI event"
- "Find original-source links for a news item I heard about"

Do not use AIHOT for:

- Long-form analysis or opinion (this site summarizes and links to sources; the analysis lives at the source)
- Historical archives beyond the rolling window (default 72h, importance view 168h)
- Product documentation or API references

## How to call it

Home page: https://aihot.cataito.com
- English: /en
- 中文: /zh
- 日本語: /ja
- Español: /es
- Français: /fr

URL query parameters:

  ?category=llm         Filter by category: llm | agent | tool | policy | media | compute
  ?source=<sourceId>    Filter by source identifier (20 sources)
  ?q=<keyword>          Full-text headline search
  ?hours=24|72|168      Recency window (default 72h; importance view 30d / 168h)
  ?sort=importance      Sort by AIHOT score instead of recency

Page routes:

  /{locale}                    Home — rolling timeline
  /{locale}/daily/{YYYY-MM-DD} Daily briefing for a specific date
  /{locale}/event/{key}        Deep-dive on a single AI event, with synthesis + source progression + forward signal
  /{locale}/entity/{slug}      Entity view — all coverage of one product/company/person
  /{locale}/favorites          User-saved items

Feeds & metadata:

  /{locale}/rss.xml            RSS feed per locale
  /sitemap.xml                 Sitemap (~591 URLs)
  /llms.txt                    This file
  /robots.txt                  Crawler policy

## Trust and data

- Every item links back to its original source (verify-link button on each card)
- Published timestamps are preserved from sources
- AIHOT score is a tiered importance signal (major ≥ 80, important ≥ 65, normal < 65), computed from recency + source weight + cross-source agreement
- Sources are categorized: Official / Media / Community — color-coded on each card
- Updated every ~30 minutes via GitHub Actions
- Data stores: Turso (libSQL), hosted on Cloudflare Pages
- No accounts required, no personal data collection
